SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') AS programs_this_week,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days' AND created_at <= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') AS programs_last_week,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND program->>'error' IS NULL) AS successful_this_week,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND program->>'error' IS NOT NULL) AS failed_this_week,
  AVG(attempts) FILTER (WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') AS avg_attempts,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND attempts > 1) AS retried_this_week,
  COUNT(DISTINCT provider) AS providers_used
FROM program_runs

SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') AS leads_this_week,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days' AND created_at <= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') AS leads_last_week,
  COUNT(*) AS total_leads
FROM leads

SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') AS total_runs,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND attempts = 1) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'), 0), 1) AS first_pass_pct,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND program->>'error' IS NULL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'), 0), 1) AS success_pct
FROM program_runs
